title: Gateway usage at a glance
summary: Aggregate TritonAI LLM Gateway activity shows the scale of shared model access across UC San Diego.
source: Raw gateway usage export (all_model_usage.csv) and Triton GPT API usage report v4

metrics.label: tokens processed
metrics.definition: Total input and output tokens recorded by the gateway during the measurement period.

metrics.label: API requests
metrics.definition: Completed gateway request records during the measurement period.

metrics.label: served by self-hosted models
metrics.definition: Share of recorded tokens served by open-weight models running on UC-controlled infrastructure.

metrics.label: tokens in June
metrics.definition: Highest monthly token volume recorded in the six-month measurement period.

notes: Commercial API model families are classified as cloud; open-weight model families running on UC-controlled infrastructure are classified as self-hosted.
Approximately 0.15 billion unattributed probe and test tokens are included in the aggregate total but not in audience-level breakdowns.
